scope: Second-batch standalone software contract; archived candidate values only
input_note: Read-only snapshot hashes. Parallel main-plan updates may change that file; runtime never reads first-batch or main-plan files.

adc.source: First-batch archived TI product page, not a newly checked datasheet
adc.slot_note: ceil(1e9/fs) ns per request, at least 10000 ns. Throughput allocation, NOT ADS8866 tCONV or pin timing.
adc.adc_ready_note: Separate explicit software completion delay; synthetic 10000 ns in aligned examples, null if unknown.

dac.note: Explicit configurable delay after DAC SPI completion; real load, step, error band and gain settling remain unknown.

timing_class: All executable hardware-dependent delays are synthetic explicit inputs; null blocks execution.
